violations.why: irq_indigo can preempt the task between its two reads of v_iris (fn_saffron, then fn_fjord) and change the value, so they see inconsistent values.
irq_kestrel can fire between the two reads of v_beacon within the same expression in fn_fjord, so area is computed from inconsistent values.
irq_kestrel can write v_beacon between the read in fn_saffron and the read in fn_fjord. Interrupts are never masked, so the two reads can differ.
